data.name: Holiday Inn & Suites Hermosillo Aeropuerto by IHG
data.address: Blvd. Jesus Garcia Morales 567, Entre Blvd. Dr. Antonio Quiroga Y, Colonia El Llano, 83210 Hermosillo, Son., Mexico
data.description:
Set in a contemporary concrete building with colorful accents, this relaxed hotel is 3 km from General Ignacio Pesqueira García International Airport and 10 km from the turn-of-the-century Catedral de Hermosillo.
The warmly decorated rooms feature complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add kitchenettes with microwaves, as well as living areas with pull-out sofas. Room service is offered 24/7. Kids age 18 and under stay at no charge with an adult.
Parking and an airport shuttle are free. There's a casual restaurant/bar. Other amenities include a gym, an outdoor pool and hot tub, plus a 24-hour business center.
